content.title: WRBY Q3 Deep Dive: Revenue Miss and Guidance Reduction Amid Changing Consumer Trends
content.summary: Eyewear retailer Warby Parker (NYSE:WRBY) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales rose 15.2% year on year to $221.7 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $872.5 million at the midpoint came in 1.5% below analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $0.05 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
